value.name: explains mother-related reason
value.description: She explains that her own experience emptying her dead mother's apartment without looking in a nightstand drawer motivates her to reveal the codicil.
evidence: "Because my mother died six years ago and I emptied her apartment by myself in a weekend and I do not know to this day whether there was anything in the drawer of her nightstand because I closed it without looking, and I have wondered ever since whether what I did not look at would have changed what I knew about her."

value.name: reveals codicil exists
value.description: She tells Daniel that the codicil exists and that it will confirm his mother's decision and its kindness.
evidence: "The codicil exists. You will know what your mother decided. You will know it is not a thing your sister invented. You will know it was kind. That is what I can give you."

value.name: Daniel thanks her
value.description: Daniel responds quietly with gratitude after hearing her explanation.

value.name: she rejects his self-abasement
value.description: When Daniel begins to say he does not deserve her help, she stops him and reframes his confession as meaningful beyond the law.
evidence: "Daniel. Don't. You did what you did. You also told us. You told us in a room with all three of us in it, and you told us before we had to ask. That counts. Not for the law. For the rest of it."

value.name: Daniel leaves office
value.description: Daniel stands up, pauses at the office door, and prepares to leave after the conversation.
evidence: "He nodded. He stood up. At the door of her office he stopped."

value.name: asks to see her again
value.description: Daniel asks whether he will see her again after the estate closing.
evidence: "At the closing of the estate. Probably twice before that, for signatures."

value.name: she declines future contact
value.description: She decides that she does not think she will see Daniel again after the estate matters are finished.

value.name: estate closes in late April
value.description: The estate is finalized in late April, marking the end of the legal process.

value.name: wisteria blooms over garden
value.description: At the estate closing, the back garden wisteria is in bloom, creating a vivid seasonal backdrop.
evidence: "the wisteria over the back garden had come into bloom, heavy purple drapes of it against the brick"

value.name: air recalls Helena's description
value.description: The smell of the air through the open back door evokes something Helena had previously told Lucia.
evidence: "and the air through the open back door smelled the way Helena had told Lucia,"
